Name: Kirby N Friends Right Back At Ya
Author: JohnDraws34
Description:
Kirby and pals are coming to Stardew Valley! Enjoy their company and visit there homes! Custom map locations for each friend custom music as well as heart events!

Please note that this mod is still in progress and is subject to change bugs as well as updates to keep the fun coming. Please be sure to Custom Music as well SMAPI and Content Patcher when using for better usage. Thanks all for your attention and enjoy your Kirby!
